proposed_from.topic: Adoption-aligned uniform event-curve inference for staggered MNAR low-rank panels. Fix the eligible-cohort unit-share event estimand and use the exact Choi--Yuan Proposition A.4 block influence coefficients. Derive a uniform growing-dimensional influence representation, the full staircase-overlap covariance including shared donor-cell terms, a consistent heteroskedastic plug-in covariance, and honest studentized Gaussian-multiplier bands. Determine the weakest primitive uniform remainder envelope built from the published Choi--Yuan block ratios and prove a legal counterarray for every strictly weaker envelope claimed sharp. Use the rank-one two-horizon witness whose shared pre-treatment cell has coefficient 1/4 in each expansion and covariance product 1/16; apply the result to the Ben-Michael--Feller RTC-law event curve. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Cohort aggregation of Proposition A.4 yields the standardized array D_n^-1(tau_hat-tau)=-sum_q a_.q e_q+rho_n with unit marginal variances and maximum coefficient L_n(K). Standard high-dimensional approximation applies under the stated leverage condition. The presolve derived a sufficient primitive envelope Delta_CY,n(K)sqrt(log(K vee 2))->0 by combining the joint remainder bound with Gaussian anti-concentration. In the balanced rank-one instance, each horizon has variance 3/4; four shared pre-treatment cells contribute covariance 1/4, hence correlation 1/3. Focused checks found only scalar or fixed-functional inference, not growing event-curve coverage. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Construct Choi--Yuan-legal triangular arrays whose standardized nonlinear remainder attains the Delta_CY scale strongly enough to prove that every strictly weaker simultaneous-band envelope fails. EARLY KILL TEST: Compute the exact second-order remainder in a balanced strong-factor rank-one panel with equally split cohorts and growing K; pivot the sharp-envelope claim if it is uniformly little-o of Delta_CY for every legal split, because the required converse family would then lack an attainable witness.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest theorem is Choi--Yuan's Proposition A.4 and staggered scalar CLT; Xia--Yan--Wainwright already cover heteroskedastic pointwise and nonasymptotic inference for general scalar weighted bilinear treatment-effect functionals under a low-rank staggered staircase; and the closest whole-path template is Callaway--Sant'Anna's multiplier band. The precise unoccupied intersection is a growing event-by-cell influence array obtained from the exact Choi--Yuan block coefficients, a feasible covariance estimator that retains signed products over reused primitive cells, and a joint studentized multiplier approximation over growing horizons. The covariance product formula is supporting algebra rather than a separate theorem. The explicit rank-one \(1/3\)-correlation witness verifies normalization and noncancellation. Sharpness of the published remainder envelope is not claimed: it is isolated as an attainable-modulus open question after the early rank-one kill test exposed likely logarithmic slack.

seed_details.anchor: ChoiYuan2024MNAR, Proposition A.4, staggered-adoption theorem, heteroskedastic supplement, Introduction, and Concluding Remarks; BenMichaelFeller2026Discussion, event-time and RTC sections
seed_details.kernel: A uniform \(K_n\)-dimensional expansion with exact event-by-cell coefficients, full staircase covariance, feasible heteroskedastic plug-in, and honest multiplier sup-t coverage.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Aggregate each primitive cell's exact Proposition A.4 coefficient across cohort-horizon blocks before invoking a high-dimensional maximum theorem.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is immediate from Choi--Yuan plus a generic multiplier bootstrap. Rebuttal: the scalar proof never forms the reused-cell vector, its off-diagonal covariance, a uniform block remainder, or a feasible growing heteroskedastic covariance; the fixed \(1/3\) witness shows that independent block pasting is wrong.

seed_details.anchor: ChoiYuan2024MNAR, Proposition A.4 remainder; ChernozhukovChetverikovKoike2023NearlyOptimal, Theorem 2.1 and Proposition 2.1
seed_details.kernel: An attained primitive remainder modulus with sufficiency and a legal low-rank staircase undercoverage counterarray against every weaker envelope.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace generic high-dimensional lower arrays by an exact second-order KKT expansion that obeys one incoherent rank-one factorization and nested adoption.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: the claimed Choi--Yuan envelope is only a stack of loose inequalities, so no legal array attains it. Rebuttal after the kill test: the objection is presently credible; retain the smaller attainable modulus as an open question and drop nominal-envelope sharpness from the theorem claims.

seed_details.kernel: A tangent-space efficiency bound for the eligible event-curve linear functional and an attaining block estimator.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Embed adoption-aligned averages into the low-rank tangent experiment and project their scores jointly rather than entrywise.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: the deterministic weak-signal triangular Choi--Yuan model does not specify a stable semiparametric tangent experiment, so the bound depends on an added model. Rebuttal fails without changing the published class; the seed is dropped.

seed_details.anchor: BenMichaelFeller2026Discussion, RTC conditioning discussion; ChoiKwonLiao2024Completion; ChoiKwonLiao2026Rank, Introduction and feasible block-average theorem
seed_details.kernel: A sharp joint bias radius over a singular-value-tail class, added to the shared-cell multiplier band, with a critical tail size at which zero enters the RTC event curve.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Push a weighted operator- or nuclear-tail budget through the adoption-aligned coefficient map before studentization.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: approximate low rank is already handled by Choi--Kwon--Liao. Rebuttal: their scalar expansion does not solve the supremum-aligned deterministic tail bias or the critical whole-curve tail radius.

seed_details.kernel: A necessary-and-sufficient factor-geometry condition for combine-before-apply to dominate split-apply-combine in event-curve covariance without changing unit-share weights.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Derive both nonlinear procedures' influence arrays on the same Choi--Yuan class before comparing positive-semidefinite covariance matrices.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: averaging first mechanically reduces variance. Rebuttal: nuclear-norm estimation changes the fitted singular spaces, and unequal event eligibility plus shared donors can reverse the ordering.

seed_details.kernel: A pseudo-adoption validation selector with a uniform oracle inequality and post-selection event-curve multiplier coverage.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Prove that staircase block holdout loss controls the event-target prediction norm uniformly over the penalty, rank, and split grid.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: this is ordinary cross-validation plus sample splitting. Rebuttal: random-cell holdout targets the wrong missingness geometry, while reuse of selected residuals changes both the uniform remainder and multiplier covariance.

seed_details.kernel: Invert a block-time permutation score to obtain a finite-sample or approximation-error-controlled confidence set for the completed event path.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Define an adoption-respecting symmetry orbit whose conformity scores reuse the same completed staircase blocks.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: exact permutation validity is immediate under exchangeability. Rebuttal collapses for the target class because unit heteroskedasticity destroys the required time-permutation symmetry; the seed is dropped rather than strengthened by an alien assumption.

seed_details.kernel: Learn an exposure-duration policy from a completed heterogeneous effect surface and prove welfare regret under staircase missingness.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Convert completed unit-by-duration effects into an orthogonal policy score with low-rank nuisance error.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: the source problem estimates the effect of an enacted state law and supplies no feasible policy class or welfare decision. The objection holds, so this lane is documented and dropped.

seed_details.kernel: Match an upper and lower bound for the expected maximum half-width of simultaneous event-curve confidence bands under staggered low-rank missingness.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Lift the entrywise Bayesian Cramer--Rao experiment to the correlated eligible event functional and optimize the simultaneous critical radius.
seed_details.red_team: Cynical objection: entrywise instance optimality plus a Bonferroni factor already gives the answer. Rebuttal: shared-cell correlation can make Bonferroni far from optimal, but the required joint lower experiment is sufficiently distinct that it is deferred behind the coverage theorem.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 3 and its supporting Theorems 1–2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The band is conditional on exact low rank, independent centered sub-Gaussian cell errors on the joint analysis domain, rowwise variance structure, and the displayed primitive uniform remainder envelope.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Honest growing-horizon multiplier coverage holds under the complete-array class M^CY; it does not claim robustness to serial dependence, approximate rank, or data-selected tuning.

banked_reason: The headline proves a valid generic conditional transfer, but the event-transfer class does not imply the required high-probability nonlinear-remainder or feasible-score events.
banked_proposal_promise_gap: The advertised honest feasible growing-event-curve band and sharp attainable envelope/counterarray remain undelivered; only a conditional finite-error Gaussian transfer is established.
